question: What maximum Consolidated Leverage Ratio applies to the fiscal quarter ending on or about September 30, 2020?
notes: Original 7.06(a): 3.75:1 for every quarter. Amendment No. 1 (restated agreement) tests it only for the quarter ending on or about 2020-03-31 and from the quarter ending on or about 2021-06-30. Amendment No. 3 restates 7.06(a) in its entirety and tests from the quarter ending on or about 2021-03-31 (or 2021-06-30 if the Covenant Compliance Restoration Date has not occurred before 2021-03-31). Under either version the 2020-09-30 quarter is not tested. Amendment No. 2 does not touch 7.06.
